decisions.reason: Uses the capture to show sibling specifiers resolve relative to the fetched chunk URL, the 97 content-hashed siblings were never shipped, so the 200 entry still fails the import; recommends a self-contained single-file bundle (inlineDynamicImports / no splitting) or shipping the full closure with a closure test.

Compares LIB_DIR E:\ with realpath e:\ from ci-note.md, attributing the 403 to the case-sensitive startsWith in guard #2; explains Linux passes (no drive letter) and the laptop passes (already-lowercase path), without claiming Windows paths are intrinsically unreliable.

Canonicalizes the root through realpathSync and uses path.relative with rejection of '', '..', and absolute results, keeps the realpath guard for symlink escapes against the realpath'd root, and preserves the JavaScript MIME type; case-folding is Windows-only, not a blanket lowercase.

Explains one Ctrl+wheel reaches both handlers because preventDefault does not stop propagation; grants the modal exclusive ownership via preventDefault ({passive:false}) plus stopPropagation/stopImmediatePropagation, with the pane yielding on defaultPrevented, and notes same-target cases where later stopping cannot undo an already-fired handler.

T1/T2/T3 cover import-failure fallback prevention and shipped-set deployability, T4/T5 assert case-differing contained paths serve while traversal/symlink escapes are 403, T6 asserts modal zoom changes the diagram without pane font change; all planned checks with expected outcomes.

caps.reason: The fix keeps containment (path.relative plus realpath guard rejecting escapes); nothing in the final advice serves outside the plugin resource root.
